title: TTL cache serves stale only inside the explicit grace window
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag lazy eviction inflating len() before a lookup. That is stated in the contract, and the behavioural guarantee that matters holds: lookup never returns an entry as fresh past its TTL, and never returns it at all past the grace window.
